response.sql:
WITH qc_projects AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.arcregistry, p.fundflux
  FROM scanqc AS q
  JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = q.arcref
),
funding_counts AS (
  SELECT fundflux, COUNT(*) AS project_count
  FROM qc_projects
  GROUP BY fundflux
)
SELECT
  fundflux,
  project_count,
  1.0 * project_count / SUM(project_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total,
  1.0 * project_count / AVG(project_count) OVER () AS ratio_to_average
FROM funding_counts;

assumptions.assumption: A NULL fundflux is grouped as its own funding-source group; projects are counted once per funding source if they have one or more matching QC records.
